Inside was a single page, the ink blurred but readable. 'To whoever keeps the light: my brother sailed past you in 1987 and never forgot the beam. Thank you for bringing him home.' He carried the page upstairs, set it beside the lamp, and lit the light early.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，呼吸缓慢而均匀。路灯在空荡的街道上投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍旧固执地变换着颜色，却没有一辆车为它停留。远处的便利店亮着白色的灯，店员靠在柜台边打着哈欠。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声音。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几盏亮着，像是失眠者的眼睛。风从河面吹来，带着微凉的潮气，天边隐约泛起一线青灰，新的一天正悄悄靠近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of Russian nesting dolls: you open one and find a smaller doll that you open the same way.\n- You stop when you reach the tiniest doll that cannot be opened, and that stopping point keeps it from going on forever."}
